objective: Keep the intended ChatGPT, ClaudeCode, and DeepSeekHarness tool/skill/plugin assignments in a version-controlled registry and require task-start preflight on every material task.

guarantee_boundary.reason: Provider accounts, plugin installation, connector consent, API credentials, and runtime processes are controlled by their respective platforms and cannot be created or kept alive by a repository file or ChatGPT conversation.

task_start_contract: Resolve canonical repository and exact branch/commit before material work.
Load this routing registry plus AGENTS.md, agent_tool_skill_assignment.json, agent_capability_matrix.json, agent_plugin_inventory.json, and LIVE_LOCK.yaml when repository access is available.
For each agent, verify the actual runtime is reachable and its assigned plugin/connector is installed and authenticated before routing work.
Use the agent's own scoped plugin set; do not treat registry membership as proof of installation, authentication, or authorization.
Select tools/plugins by task relevance and least privilege; do not indiscriminately invoke every plugin for every task.
Record task ID, agent, plugin/connector, capability probe, permission scope, evidence timestamp, and outcome.
If an agent or plugin is unavailable, continue only with an available authorized substitute and explicitly report the missing delegation; do not simulate a tool call.
Never send secrets, PATs, OAuth tokens, OTPs, or production credentials to an LLM, plugin, repository, log, or evidence artifact.
No external agent or plugin may authorize capital, submit live orders, modify LIVE_LOCK, or set FINAL_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION.

ChatGPT.role: supervisory orchestrator, evidence reconciliation, independent review
ChatGPT.activation_rule: Use currently exposed and authorized tools for this conversation; verify each relevant connector at task time. Do not claim a background worker or always-on connection.

ClaudeCode.activation_rule: Require a reachable ClaudeCode runtime and connector-level probe before delegation. Repo plugin metadata or skill files alone are insufficient.

DeepSeekHarness.role: independent harness/code review, adversarial validation, CI/evidence critique
DeepSeekHarness.activation_rule: Keep shadow-only until a real authorized endpoint/runtime is configured and verified. Do not invent an endpoint or credentials.
